'''1999 Endor Regionals Douglas Harvilla DS''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Douglas Harvilla]]
* '''Event:''' [[1999 Endor Regionals]]
* '''Stage:''' Published lists
* '''Finish:''' 2nd
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HD Harvilla DS 1999 EndorReg.txt |Download]]
